g.text: Shared model service resource timelines (descriptive only)
Different experiments aligned by elapsed time. Four tasks share a model service. Raw samples remain in the released data.
Display uses 1-min sample means (GPU) / peaks (KV); missing bins are not interpolated. GPU utilization is not HBM bandwidth.
Allocated KV blocks do not measure all resident reusable cache. Sampling/clock limits apply.
